data.narrative:
9 Mothers is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Russell Smith, Roman Khomenko, and Bogdan Pyzh that has raised $4.5M to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both private and public markets, including Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $4.5M raised as a proxy for base value, yielding $11.25M. Peer-Median uses the median valuation across the 4-company comp set of $700M. The peer universe exhibits wide dispersion, ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), reflecting heterogeneity in stage, traction, and market positioning within Defense & Security.

The triangulated analysis implies a range of $10M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $356M. The wide spread reflects the tension between 9 Mothers' early Seed stage and the substantial valuations commanded by later-stage peers in an active frontier-defense sector. Key uncertainties include the company's differentiation relative to well-funded peers like Anduril and Shield AI, revenue traction, and customer validation. A post-Seed valuation would require evidence of technical progress and go-to-market execution.
